{{Quote|With more than 50 dead and 250 injured, as well as an estimated 50 million credits in property damage, the strike ranks as the worst atrocity to hit Esseles since the Algeran Faction attacks during Emperor Palpatine's ascension to the throne.|A [[Darpa SectorNet]] report|<ref name="GNN8" />}}
A series of '''terrorist attacks''' on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] took place in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The Rebel group [[Faceless]] attacked simultaneously several targets on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. On the one hand, the Faceless struck the [[DynaCorp]] Refinery on the [[Grande Hyet]] island. The explosion utterly destroyed the major fuel depot and refinery and caused major damage to the local [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The attack made 50 dead and 250 injured, as well 50 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in property damage. On the other hand, the Faceless attacked the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installation at [[Tralee]].

This series of terrorist strikes was considered to be the worst atrocities to hit Esseles since the [[Algeran Faction]] attacks during the rise to power of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Response to the disaster was delayed due to a quarrel of jurisdiction between [[Esselian Hall]] [[President/Legends|President]] [[Cambira Ralle]] and Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Griff Takel]].
